boundary_rule: A value exactly on a break is assigned to the lower class.
citation: Coops et al. 2016, A forest structure habitat index based on airborne laser scanning data, Ecological Indicators 67:346-357, doi:10.1016/j.ecolind.2016.02.057
notes: First-return statistics from the two public LidarBC 2024 LAZ tiles over the TFL6 1 km AOI; normalized with the FEMIC 1 m DEM.
weights: Equal components; the published product has no weights.
